To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a closed form bound on the probability of deadline misses can be obtained for a reservation based soft real-time task, (2) the probability of deadline missing can be computed with an arbitrary accuracy by solving a periodic Discrete Time Markow Chain, and (3) the proposed methodology can be used to optimise the Quality of Service of reservation based systems.
the probability of a miss can be computed with an accuracy/computation time that depends on the model granularity.

we have developed an efficient technique to compute the probability of deadline misses for a set of periodic tasks sharing a resource, and we have proposed a simple and effective bound for the probability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology for the analysis of the probabilistic guarantees of reservation based real-time systems.
the development of a methodology for the analysis and design of soft real-time systems with probabilistic QoS.
the computation of a probabilistic guarantee for the performance of a reservation based soft real-time system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our technique provides a good trade-off between the accuracy of the results and the computational effort required for the solution.
the proposed methodology can be used to obtain a very accurate solution for the probability of deadline misses in real-time systems.
the proposed methodology is an efficient and accurate tool that allows for the analysis and design of reservation based real-time systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the methodology proposed in this paper provides a practical tool for the analysis and optimisation of reservation based real-time systems with probabilistic guarantees.

the proposed model and its associated bounds provide a very good solution in terms of accuracy and time for the problem of computing probabilistic guarantees of reservation based soft real-time systems.

we provide a methodology that can be used to compute the probability of deadline misses for a periodic real time task scheduled by a reservation algorithm, and a conservative upper bound for the same.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed modelling and numeric solution technique is a viable option for the analysis of reservation based soft real-time systems, and that the proposed bound can be used for a fast optimisation of the system parameters.
the proposed modelling approach can be used for the analysis and design of reservation based real-time systems.
it offers an analytical methodology for the computation and the bounding of the probability of a soft real-time deadline miss in reservation based real-time systems.
